group.label: Catalog Storefront Document Store
group.comment: The document store serves product and category reads from OpenSearch documents that the commerce-data-export feeds build, without database queries on the request. Part of the GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront modules.

field.label: Enable Storefront Indexing
field.comment: Writes the feeds into the document store as they export. The feeds mark their rows as exported either way, so after a period with indexing off the feed tables must be truncated and the feeds reindexed.

field.label: Serve GraphQL From Documents
field.comment: Catalog GraphQL reads come from the documents. A product without a document falls back to the database.

field.label: Record Search Terms
field.comment: Core records every search term and its popularity in the database, the last database write on a document-served listing. Off stops the search terms report and the search suggestions from updating.
